text: For 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31, with “phone” treated as handset and units_sold used, the top 10 models were Kestrel Pika 2 (7201), Kestrel Pika 3 (7198), Kestrel Pika 1 (7190), Kestrel Tern 2 (5295), Kestrel Tern 1 (5280), Kestrel Tern 3 (5248), Kestrel Tern 4 (5180), Kestrel Swift 4 (4293), Kestrel Swift 1 (4224), and Kestrel Swift 2 (4186).
